description:
This process begins when a potential customer inquires about a product or service.
Sales staff or customer support collects relevant information and addresses any concerns or questions.
If the customer is interested, they are guided through selecting the appropriate product or service.
Next, the sales representative provides a quote, and after approval from the customer, the process moves to order placement.
The order is then recorded in the system, and the customer receives confirmation of their order.
The process ends when the order is successfully placed and confirmed.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_SalesOrder" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/sales-order">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_SalesOrder" name="Sales and Order Placement" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Main">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Inquiry</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_QuoteApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_QuoteNotApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_OrderConfirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesSupport" name="Sales Staff / Customer Support">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ReceiveTask_Inquiry</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectInfo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddressConcerns</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Interested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GuideSelection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideQuote</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ServiceTask_RecordOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_SendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NotInterested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Inquiry" name="Potential customer inquires about product or service">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_Inquiry" name="Receive customer inquiry">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CollectInfo" name="Collect relevant information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddressConcerns" name="Address concerns and questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Interested" name="Customer interested?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Interested</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotInterested</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuideSelection" name="Guide customer through product or service selection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Interested</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideQuote" name="Provide quote">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_QuoteApproved" name="Customer approves quote?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_RecordOrder" name="Record order in system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed" name="Order successfully placed and confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotInterested" name="Customer not interested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotInterested</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_QuoteNotApproved" name="Quote not approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Inquiry" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Inquiry"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_Inquiry" targetRef="Task_CollectInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_CollectInfo" targetRef="Task_AddressConcerns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_AddressConcerns" targetRef="Gateway_Interested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interested" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested" targetRef="Task_GuideSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${interested == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInterested" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested" targetRef="EndEvent_NotInterested">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${interested == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_GuideSelection" targetRef="Task_ProvideQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Gateway_QuoteApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_QuoteApproved" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${quoteApproved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_QuoteApproved" targetRef="EndEvent_QuoteNotApproved">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${quoteApproved == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="ServiceTask_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="ServiceTask_RecordOrder" targetRef="SendTask_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="SendTask_SendConfirmation" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
